WITH counted AS (
  SELECT zoneref, articount
  FROM scanfeatures
  WHERE articount IS NOT NULL
), totals AS (
  SELECT SUM(articount) AS overall_total
  FROM counted
), shares AS (
  SELECT c.zoneref, c.articount,
         c.articount::numeric / NULLIF(t.overall_total, 0) AS share
  FROM counted AS c
  CROSS JOIN totals AS t
  WHERE t.overall_total IS NOT NULL
), averaged AS (
  SELECT zoneref, articount, share,
         AVG(share) OVER () AS average_share
  FROM shares
)
SELECT zoneref, articount, share,
       share - average_share AS share_minus_average
FROM averaged
WHERE average_share IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY share_minus_average DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 10

assumptions.assumption: Each non-null scanfeatures row is one count whose share is compared with the mean share across those rows; the overall artifact total sums non-null articount values. A zero total yields no rows because the shares are undefined.
